warrant: The observable is every cell of every prognostic field in the final state dump, compared as |c - r| <= 1e-10 + 1e-08|r|; the relative part is the working bound because the graded fields span many orders of magnitude, the absolute part covers cells at or near zero. The observable is every cell of the final state dump (U, V, W, T, S, Eta, PH, PHL) plus the momDiag and viscDiag files that dumpAtLast writes at the final iteration, graded relatively with an absolute floor. The bound is physical because the coefficient under test is not a tuned constant but a formula evaluated from the resolved vorticity and divergence gradients: it has one right answer per cell per step and every fault above displaces it by parts in a hundred or worse, many orders of magnitude above the round-off floor. It is achievable at a short window because the only tolerance-bearing step is the barotropic solve, and the deck sets cg2dTargetResidual=1e-11, tight enough that the residual falls well past the threshold in a fixed number of iterations and the solve contributes no realistic iteration-count sensitivity; everything else in the step, the viscosity formulas, the advection with its continuous flux limiter and the implicit vertical solves, is fixed-length direct arithmetic with no convergence test, and the run is a single process with a deterministic tile sweep, so two runs of the same build agree bit for bit and the whole measured spread is the amplification of the deliberate two-ulp change. Two hours is also short compared with the days it takes a 1 km front on an f-plane at f0=7.29e-5 to roll up into eddies, so the comparison is made on a laminar adjusting front rather than on a turbulent field, which is what keeps a pointwise rule honest. The measured behaviour of this experiment is the governing fact for this check. A native window scan on the x86_64 host on 2026-09-02, using the sibling deck input.QGLthGM and a one-ulp variant of viscC2LeithQG, found the worst relative spread in salinity growing steadily and smoothly with the window: 7.5e-10 at 6 steps, 7.8e-9 at 12, 1.4e-8 at 24, 4.7e-8 at 36 and 9.5e-8 at 48. That is continuous amplification, not a threshold flipping, and it has two sources that every MLAdjust deck shares. The first is the closure itself: the viscosity is a function of the flow gradients and the viscosity in turn sets the flow gradients, so a perturbation feeds back on itself every step through pkg/mom_common/mom_calc_visc.F. The second is the spice tracer: salinity is stepped with sBeta=0, so it carries a finite vertical gradient across interfaces where the temperature gradient, and hence the density gradient, is neutral, and the strict sign test of model/src/calc_ivdc.F can flip such an interface between a vertical diffusivity of 1e-5 and 10 m2/s while the temperature flux stays negligible. That is why salinity, not temperature, carries the largest spread. The same two mechanisms are present in this deck with the same grid, the same initial front, the same ivdc_kappa and the same class of flow-dependent viscosity, so the same amplification must be expected until it is measured here, and the check is graded over 6 steps, two hours, half the upstream twelve-step window, where the sibling's spread sat thirteen times inside the rule, and is flagged chaotic. That scan was run on 2026-09-05 (below) and the window was lengthened to the upstream twelve on its result. Measured on 2026-09-05 from the retained runs: at 6 steps the two-ulp viscC4leith variant left Eta, PH, PHL, S, T, U, V, W and momDiag bit-identical and moved viscDiag alone, by 7.6e-8 of the bound; at 12 steps U and V move by 8.4e-9 and 1.0e-9 of the bound, momDiag by 2.7e-13 and viscDiag by 8.6e-8, so the window is the upstream twelve and the variant reaches the state, faintly; the check's discrimination rests on viscDiag, the viscosity the closure returns, where both fault probes land more than 1e7 over. Faults: Because there is no background biharmonic viscosity, the entire lateral dissipation is whatever mom_calc_visc.F returns, so a fault there cannot be masked. Getting the power of the grid spacing wrong in the biharmonic Leith coefficient (it enters as the fifth power of the grid scale divided by pi) changes the viscosity by an order of magnitude and the graded VA4DLTH and VA4ZLTH fields by O(1). Using only the vorticity gradient and dropping the divergence part, that is ignoring viscC4leithD, leaves the divergent modes undamped and changes momHDiv by parts in 1e-1 within two hours. Applying the viscA4GridMax cap to the sum instead of to each contribution, or before instead of after the Smagorinsky term, changes only the strongly strained cells but by a factor of order one there. Evaluating the closure on vorticity points with the tracer-point metric terms, a classic error on a C grid, changes VISCA4Z by tens of percent. Single-precision viscosity leaves around 1e-7 relative in the velocity field. The expensive path under test is pkg/mom_common/mom_calc_visc.F, which forms the Leith, Leith-divergence and Smagorinsky contributions on both vorticity and divergence points and applies the grid-scaled maximum, and the vector-invariant momentum routines of pkg/mom_vecinv (mom_vi_hdissip.F and the vorticity and divergence term routines) that use them, with model/src/calc_ivdc.F and model/src/impldiff.F handling the convective and implicit vertical parts and the third-order flux-limited advection of model/src/gad_dst3fl.F carrying the two tracers.. The nominal-versus-variant spread recorded by selfcheck is the measurement of the round-off amplification under this exact rule, and the bound is finalised against it with the human.
